Name: todos.list
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Reads active buckets (open, in-progress, deferred, completed) via stat-keyed cache; reads archived/YYYY/MM on demand

Name: todos.get
Signature_or_Type: at, id -> task (with rev and description)
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Reads single task file fresh from vfs.FS and computes SHA-256 rev token

Name: todos.add
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Creates <date>-<slug>.md in open/ (or in-progress/ if assignee set); stamps lifecycle timestamps; journals create

Name: todos.update
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Updates hand-editable frontmatter fields conditional on rev; symbolizes $KB_ROOT/$PROJECT_ROOT refs; refuses status/assignee

Name: todos.status
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Atomically moves task file across bucket directories; updates status_changed, completed_at, or archived_at

Name: todos.assign
Signature_or_Type: at, id, rev, assignee, reason? -> task
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Sets assignee; promotes open -> in-progress in the same write (D1); records assign op in todo_change for consumers

Name: todos.remove
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: 3-phase delete via .trash/<seq>-<file> -> staged -> unlink; preserves audit entry in todo_change

Name: todos.refresh
Signature_or_Type: at -> {scanned, moved, archived, errors_set, rewritten, malformed}
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Reconciles misplaced bucket files, validates adr/review/blocked into errors[], and auto-archives completed tasks > 28 days

Name: todos.changes
Signature_or_Type: at, consumer, limit?, scoped? -> {changes[] | resync, snapshot, cursor}
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Pulls committed journal entries after consumer's acked_seq, or triggers full snapshot resync if > 90 days idle; without scoped, a scoped assignment comes without its assignee

Name: todos.ack
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Advances durable consumer cursor in todo_consumer once external notifications are delivered

Name: todos.resolve
Signature_or_Type: at -> {store_id, store, root, override?, writable, claimed}
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Resolves workspace name or {root} map to canonical .todo-list directory and ownership state

Name: todos.scaffold
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Creates .todo-list/ bucket hierarchy and writes .autodoc-owner marker for a claimed store

Name: todos.vars
Signature_or_Type: at -> [{name, value?, builtin, derived?, source?, machine?, conflict?}]
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Lists effective symbolic path variables ($KB_ROOT, $PROJECT_ROOT, $HOME, and custom vars)

Name: id
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Immutable task identifier matching filename stem; never edit by hand

Name: version
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Selects embedded schema core/todo/formats/v1.yaml; versions newer than binary are flagged malformed

Name: status
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Must match parent bucket directory; reconciled on refresh

Name: title
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Mirrored to the # <title> H1 heading immediately below YAML frontmatter

Name: priority
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Optional triage weight; omitted from YAML when unset

Name: due
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Optional target date kept as unquoted date string

Name: assignee
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Direct YAML edit is metadata-only; todos.assign triggers D1 transition and consumer notification

Name: created
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Stamped once by todos.add; immutable thereafter

Name: updated
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Updated on any daemon write or detected hand-edit snapshot diff

Name: status_changed
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Updated whenever status transitions between buckets

Name: completed_at
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Stamped on transition to completed; retained if subsequently archived; cleared otherwise

Name: archived_at
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Stamped when moved to archived/YYYY/MM/ via todos.status or 28-day refresh

Name: tags
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Categorical labels indexed for filtering in todos.list and workspace search

Name: adr
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Governing ADR references; absolute paths normalized to longest matching symbolic variable on write

Name: review
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Code/design review references; validated for existence during refresh

Name: blocked
Signature_or_Type: list of task IDs or symbolic doc refs
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Resolvable task IDs or $KB_ROOT doc refs; prose causes Task '...' does not exist diagnostic

Name: errors
Signature_or_Type: list of maps ({code, detected, field, message})
Side_Effects_and_Behavior: Populated by todos.refresh for missing refs, unresolved variables, or missing blocker IDs
